method: three independent auditor agents (numeric recomputation / data construction / governance+receipts), each recomputing from committed raw artifacts only; no protected-split record materialized, read, or printed by any auditor; read-only except this report
headline: ZERO numerical discrepancies. The raw committed data fully support the emitted status NO_PATH_B_OPERATION_SIGNAL; no other status was reachable. Governance clean (no protected read, no prohibited claim-use, status not rewritten, spend arithmetic verified). Findings short of discrepancy: one unverifiable P0 gate, a weak-as-coded best-family-removal clause (owner concern SUBSTANTIATED with exact residual margins), two cache-robustness gaps, and receipt-form gaps on four runs (retroactive receipt filed).
